prompt_diff_summary.title: Immediate pitch drop
prompt_diff_summary.description: Stop pitching immediately on any busy, driving, meeting, or rescheduling cue, including after polite filler.

prompt_diff_summary.title: Resolve self-corrections
prompt_diff_summary.description: Discard retracted day and time mentions; use only the final corrected preference.

prompt_diff_summary.title: Verify calendar and confirm in two steps
prompt_diff_summary.description: Propose one exact available slot without a Turn-1 tool call; book only after Turn-2 confirmation of that pending slot.

prompt_diff_summary.title: Voice brevity and verified facts
prompt_diff_summary.description: Use at most 24 spoken words and never invent unverified fees or availability.
